question:
(a) State the principle on which an AC generator works.
(b) If the angular speed of rotation of the coil is increased, how is the maximum induced emf affected? Justify your answer.

options.A:
An AC generator works on electrostatic induction.
Increasing angular speed decreases the maximum induced emf.
options.B:
An AC generator works on electromagnetic induction.
Increasing angular speed does not affect the maximum induced emf.
options.C:
An AC generator works on self-induction.
Increasing angular speed decreases the maximum induced emf.
options.D:
An AC generator works on electromagnetic induction.
Since $\varepsilon_0=NBA\omega$, the maximum induced emf increases in direct proportion to angular speed; doubling $\omega$ doubles $\varepsilon_0$.
